payout_quote: To receive the $400 bonus, open any new Univest consumer checking account between September 14, 2026, and November 25, 2026, and have qualifying direct deposits totaling at least $1,000 credited to the account within 90 calendar days of account opening.
steps: Open any new Univest consumer checking account at https://www.univest.net/fall400 between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-25 (you must not currently have a Univest consumer checking account, and must not have closed one or received a checking incentive in the past 12 months).

Within 90 calendar days of opening, receive qualifying direct deposits (ACH payroll, pension, or government benefits) totaling at least $1,000 — transfers, Zelle, RTP, mobile/ATM/branch deposits do not qualify.
Keep the account open with a positive balance; the $400 bonus is credited within 30 business days after the 90-day qualification period.
catches: $1,000 in qualifying direct deposits (ACH payroll, pension, or government benefits) within 90 calendar days of opening; transfers, Zelle, RTP, mobile/ATM/branch deposits and debit-card loads do not qualify.
New Univest consumer checking customers only: must not currently have one, must not have closed one or received a checking incentive in the past 12 months; business accounts excluded.
Limit one bonus per household (same residential address); no partial bonus.
Bonus credited up to 30 business days AFTER the 90-day qualification period — roughly four months from opening to payout.
Account must be open with a positive balance at payout; closed, restricted, or charged-off accounts get nothing.
Bonus is taxable (1099); offer can be modified or ended at any time; expires 2026-11-25.
biggest_catch: $1,000 in qualifying ACH direct deposits within 90 days — and the $400 is not paid until up to 30 business days after the 90-day qualification period ends.
eligibility: No current Univest consumer checking account; no Univest checking closed or checking incentive received in the past 12 months; business accounts not eligible; one bonus per household; account approval required.
timing: Bonus credited within 30 business days after the 90-day qualification period.
